text: Binary per-post measure over other users' comments (OC_comments, JSON list of non-OP comments; order is not chronology or rank), using title and argument only to identify the OP's view. Returns 1 if at least one single comment first explicitly acknowledges that the OP's position has a valid, reasonable or partly correct underlying point (a concession that something in the view is right, not mere politeness, thanks or restating it) and then later in that same comment introduces a discrepancy, counterpoint or disagreement; acknowledgment must precede the objection, and separate comments cannot combine. Returns 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does this (pure refutation, agreement only, or acknowledgment only after the objection). Returns null if OC_comments is empty, missing or malformed, or if OP title/argument is missing. Ignores view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thanks or resolution updates, and text reporting the outcome, even inside argument or comments; generic discussion of delta or platform rules may still count. Uses current text as supplied, without reconstructing the original.
